## Why

Describe the problem and the security/correctness reason for this change.

## Evidence

- [ ] Success behavior is tested.
- [ ] Refusal and malformed-input behavior is tested where relevant.
- [ ] New behavior was sabotaged in both directions and the intended tests failed.
- [ ] Secret leakage, permissions, overwrite, and network behavior were considered.
- [ ] Local gates pass.
- [ ] Documentation states guarantees and limits.

## Risk and recovery

Describe the trust boundary, failure modes, compatibility impact, and rollback.
